shortBulletSummary: The Fear & Greed Index remains in the "fear" zone (28-31), with Bitcoin consolidating around $65,000 amid contracting trading volumes.
The CLARITY Act, a key US crypto regulation bill, is stalled due to political disputes, prolonging market uncertainty.
Escalating Middle East tensions are driving oil prices higher, increasing inflation fears, and impacting global risk assets, including crypto.
Stronger US employment data boosts Fed rate hike expectations, while concerns over AI investment returns pressure tech stocks and broader markets.
Spot Bitcoin ETFs have recorded six consecutive days of net inflows, and BNY Mellon is piloting tokenized Treasury products.
